lines: // The boss of the current fight, if there is one.
// Using a nether star summons the boss in front of the player.
players[i].showTitle("The Ravager King", { subtitle: "has awoken", stay: 40 });
// Players who join during the fight see the bar too.
// After each hit, the bar shows the health left.
// When the boss falls: remove the bar and reward whoever killed it.

meta.notes: A script with a boss bar. msm.bossBars.create makes a bar of this project's namespace (at most 32), shown to the players added to it; setProgress sets how full it is, from 0 to 1. entity.damaged runs after every hit with the health already lowered, so the bar follows the boss's health, and entity.death removes the bar, shows the killer a title and gives five experience levels. Boss bars are not saved: after /reload or a restart the bar is gone and the ravager is an ordinary one. Scripts run only in the Fabric mod jar export, with msm_runtime; the Java project export leaves them out.
